#1
मदनुग्रहाय|mad-anugrahāya|mad — me, my (stem form of aham in compounds);;anugraha — favor, grace (dat. sg. 'for my favor', i.e. to show me grace)
परमं|paramam|parama — supreme (sg. neut., agreeing with guhyam and, in the next line, vacaḥ)
गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्|guhyam adhyātma-saṃjñitam|guhya — secret, mystery (sg. neut., in apposition with vacaḥ 'the word', line 2);;adhyātma — pertaining to the self, the oversoul (adhi + ātman; the technical term Kṛṣṇa used for it in ch. 8);;saṃjñita — called, termed, named (past participle of sam-jñā; sg. neut.: 'called adhyātma')
--
यत्त्वयोक्तं|yat tvayā uktam|yad — which, that (yat: sg. neut. relative; nom. and acc. are the same form for a neuter);;tvad — you (tvayā: instr. sg. 'by you');;vac — to speak (ukta: past participle 'spoken, said', sg. neut.; yat + tvayā stay unchanged in writing, -t + t-; tvayā + ukta- → tvayokta-, -ā + u- → -o-)
वचस्तेन|vacaḥ tena|vacas — word, speech (vacaḥ: sg. neut.; -aḥ + t- → -as t-)
मोहोऽयं|mohaḥ ayam|moha — delusion, confusion (nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha marking the lost a-);;idam — this (ayam: nom. sg. masc.)
विगतो|vigataḥ|vi-gam — to go away, depart (vigata: past participle 'gone, departed', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before m- → -o)
मम|mama|aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'my')
#2
भवाप्ययौ|bhava-apyayau|bhava — coming-into-being, origin;;apyaya — passing-away, dissolution (bhavāpyayau: 'origin and dissolution', a dvandva pair-compound, nom. dual masc.; bhava + apyayau → bhavāpyayau, a + a → ā)
हि|hi|hi — indeed, for (particle)
भूतानां|bhūtānām|bhūta — being, creature (gen. pl. 'of beings')
श्रुतौ|śrutau|śru — to hear (śruta: past participle 'heard', nom. dual masc., agreeing with bhavāpyayau in a passive sense: 'have been heard')
विस्तरशो|vistaraśaḥ|vistaraśas — in detail, at length (adverb from vistara 'extent, detail' + distributive suffix -śas; -aḥ before m- → -o)
मया|mayā|aham — I (mayā: instr. sg. 'by me')
--
त्वत्तः|tvattaḥ|tvad — you (tvattaḥ: abl. sg. 'from you', with the emphatic ablative suffix -tas, as in mattaḥ 'from me')
कमलपत्राक्ष|kamala-patra-akṣa|kamala — lotus;;patra — leaf, petal;;akṣa — eye (kamalapatrākṣa: 'lotus-petal-eyed', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa; patra + akṣa → patrākṣa, a + a → ā)
माहात्म्यमपि|māhātmyam api|māhātmya — greatness, majesty (abstract noun from mahātman; acc. sg. neut.);;api — also, too
चाव्ययम्|ca avyayam|ca — and;;avyaya — imperishable, undiminishing (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with māhātmyam; ca + avyayam → cāvyayam, a + a → ā)
#3
एवमेतद्यथात्थ|evam etat yathā āttha|evam — thus, in this way;;etad — this (etat: acc. sg. neut.; final -t before y- written -d, voicing);;yathā — as, in the way that;;ah — to say (āttha: perfect 2nd sg., an irregular defective-verb form, 'you have said'; etat + yathā → etad yathā, -t + y- → -d y-; yathā + āttha → yathāttha, ā + ā → ā)
त्वमात्मानं|tvam ātmānam|tvam — you (nom. sg.);;ātman — self (ātmānam: acc. sg. 'the self, yourself', object of āttha)
परमेश्वर|parama-īśvara|parama — supreme;;īśvara — lord (parameśvara: 'supreme lord', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa; parama + īśvara → parameśvara, a + ī → e)
--
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि|draṣṭum icchāmi|dṛś — to see (draṣṭum: infinitive 'to see');;iṣ — to wish, desire (icchāmi: present 1st sg. 'I wish')
ते|te|tvam — you (te: enclitic gen. sg. 'your')
रूपमैश्वरं|rūpam aiśvaram|rūpa — form (acc. sg. neut.);;aiśvara — belonging to Īśvara, lordly, majestic, divine (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
पुरुषोत्तम|puruṣa-uttama|puruṣa — person, being;;uttama — highest, best (puruṣottama: 'highest of persons', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa; puruṣa + uttama → puruṣottama, a + u → o)
#4
मन्यसे|manyase|man — to think (manyase: present middle 2nd sg. 'you think')
यदि|yadi|yadi — if
तच्छक्यं|tat śakyam|tad — that, it (tat: acc. sg. neut.; -t + ś- → -c ch-);;śakya — possible, able to be done (gerundive of śak; acc. sg. neut.)
मया|mayā|aham — I (mayā: instr. sg. 'by me')
द्रष्टुमिति|draṣṭum iti|dṛś — to see (draṣṭum: infinitive);;iti — thus (closes the reported thought 'you think that it is possible to be seen by me')
प्रभो|prabho|prabhu — lord, master (vocative sg. 'prabho', the regular vocative form of a u-stem)
--
योगेश्वर|yoga-īśvara|yoga — yoga;;īśvara — lord (yogeśvara: 'lord of yoga', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa; yoga + īśvara → yogeśvara, a + ī → e)
ततो|tataḥ|tatas — then, therefore (-aḥ before m- → -o)
मे|me|aham — I (me: enclitic dat. sg. 'to me')
त्वं|tvam|tvam — you (nom. sg.)
दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम्|darśaya ātmānam avyayam|dṛś — to see (darśaya: causative imperative 2nd sg. 'show!'; darśaya + ātmānam → darśayātmānam, a + ā → ā);;ātman — self (ātmānam: acc. sg.);;avyaya — imperishable, undiminishing (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with ātmānam)
#5
पश्य|paśya|dṛś/paś — to see (paśya: imperative 2nd sg. 'behold!')
मे|me|aham — I (me: enclitic gen. sg. 'my')
पार्थ|pārtha|Pārtha — 'son of Pṛthā', Arjuna (vocative sg.)
रूपाणि|rūpāṇi|rūpa — form (acc. pl. neut.)
शतशोऽथ|śataśaḥ atha|śataśas — by the hundreds, hundredfold (adverb; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha);;atha — and, moreover
सहस्रशः|sahasraśaḥ|sahasraśas — by the thousands, thousandfold (adverb)
--
नानाविधानि|nānā-vidhāni|nānā — various, of many kinds;;vidha — kind, sort (nānāvidhāni: acc. pl. neut., 'of many kinds', agreeing with rūpāṇi)
दिव्यानि|divyāni|divya — divine (acc. pl. neut.)
नानावर्णाकृतीनि|nānā-varṇa-ākṛtīni|nānā — various;;varṇa — color;;ākṛti — shape, form (nānāvarṇākṛtīni: acc. pl. neut., 'of many colors and shapes'; varṇa + ākṛtīni → varṇākṛtīni, a + ā → ā)
च|ca|ca — and
#6
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ|paśya ādityān vasūn rudrān aśvinau|dṛś/paś — to see (paśya: imperative 'behold!'; paśya + ādityān → paśyādityān, a + ā → ā);;Āditya — the Ādityas, a class of solar deities, sons of Aditi (acc. pl.);;Vasu — the Vasus, eight deities of the natural elements (acc. pl.; final -n before v- stays -n);;Rudra — the Rudras, eleven fierce storm-deities, forms of Śiva (acc. pl.; final -n before r- stays -n);;Aśvin — the two Aśvins, twin gods of healing and the dawn (acc. dual; final -n before a vowel stays -n and joins directly)
मरुतस्तथा|marutaḥ tathā|Marut — the Maruts, storm-gods, companions of Indra (acc. pl.; -aḥ + t- → -as t-);;tathā — likewise, also
--
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि|bahūni adṛṣṭa-pūrvāṇi|bahu — many (bahūni: acc. pl. neut.; -i + a- → -y a-);;a-dṛṣṭa-pūrva — not seen before, unprecedented (a- 'not' + dṛṣṭa 'seen', past participle of dṛś, + pūrva 'previous', used adverbially: 'never seen before'; acc. pl. neut.)
पश्याश्चर्याणि|paśya āścaryāṇi|dṛś/paś — to see (paśya: imperative 'behold!'; paśya + āścaryāṇi → paśyāścaryāṇi, a + ā → ā);;āścarya — wonder, marvel (acc. pl. neut.)
भारत|bhārata|Bhārata — descendant of Bharata (vocative sg.; here addressed to Arjuna)
#7
इहैकस्थं|iha eka-stham|iha — here;;eka-stha — standing in one place, united (eka 'one' + stha 'standing'; acc. sg. neut.; iha + eka- → ihaika-, a + e → ai)
जगत्कृत्स्नं|jagat kṛtsnam|jagat — world, universe (acc. sg. neut.);;kṛtsna — whole, entire (acc. sg. neut.)
पश्याद्य|paśya adya|dṛś/paś — to see (paśya: imperative 'behold!');;adya — today, now (paśya + adya → paśyādya, a + a → ā)
सचराचरम्|sa-cara-acaram|sa- — with, together with (prefix);;cara — moving, that which moves;;a-cara — unmoving, motionless (a- 'not' + cara; sacarācaram: 'together with the moving and the unmoving', acc. sg. neut.; cara + acaram → carācaram, a + a → ā)
--
मम|mama|aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'my')
देहे|dehe|deha — body (loc. sg. 'in [my] body')
गुडाकेश|guḍākeśa|Guḍākeśa — 'thick-haired' or 'conqueror of sleep', Arjuna (vocative sg.)
यच्चान्यद्|yat ca anyat|yad — which, whatever (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative; -t + c- → -c c-);;ca — and;;anya — other, another (anyat: acc. sg. neut.; the pronominal declension ends in -t, not -m; ca + anyat → cānyat, a + a → ā; final -t before the following voiced d- of draṣṭum surfaces as -d)
द्रष्टुमिच्छसि|draṣṭum icchasi|dṛś — to see (draṣṭum: infinitive);;iṣ — to wish, desire (icchasi: present 2nd sg. 'you wish')
#8
न|na|na — not
तु|tu|tu — but

शक्यसे|śakyase|śak — to be able (śakyase: present passive 2nd sg. of the gerundive śakya, used personally with an infinitive: 'you are able [to see]')
द्रष्टुमनेनैव|draṣṭum anena eva|dṛś — to see (draṣṭum: infinitive);;idam — this (anena: instr. sg. masc. 'with this');;eva — indeed, just, very (anena + eva → anenaiva, a + e → ai)
स्वचक्षुषा|sva-cakṣuṣā|sva — own;;cakṣus — eye (svacakṣuṣā: instr. sg., 'with [your] own eye')

एवमुक्त्वा|evam uktvā|evam — thus;;vac — to speak (uktvā: gerund 'having said')

राजन्महायोगेश्वरो|rājan mahā-yoga-īśvaraḥ|rājan — king (vocative sg., Sañjaya addressing Dhṛtarāṣṭra);;mahā — great;;yoga — yoga;;īśvara — lord (mahāyogeśvaraḥ: 'the great lord of yoga', nom. sg., in apposition to hariḥ; yoga + īśvara → yogeśvara, a + ī → e; final -aḥ before h- → -o)
हरिः|hariḥ|Hari — 'Hari', a name of Kṛṣṇa/Viṣṇu (nom. sg.)
--
दर्शयामास|darśayām āsa|dṛś — to see (darśayām āsa: causative periphrastic perfect 3rd sg., 'he showed', a formation used for some derived verbs in the perfect)

परमं|paramam|parama — supreme (acc. sg. neut.)

#10
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्|aneka-vaktra-nayanam aneka-adbhuta-darśanam|aneka — many, numerous;;vaktra — mouth, face;;nayana — eye (anekavaktranayanam: 'having many mouths and eyes', acc. sg., a bahuvrīhi describing the form Kṛṣṇa now reveals);;aneka — many;;adbhuta — wonderful, marvelous;;darśana — sight, appearance, aspect (anekādbhutadarśanam: 'of many marvelous aspects', acc. sg.; aneka + adbhuta → anekādbhuta, a + a → ā)
--
अनेकदिव्याभरणं|aneka-divya-ābharaṇam|aneka — many;;divya — divine;;ābharaṇa — ornament, adornment (anekadivyābharaṇam: 'having many divine ornaments', acc. sg.; divya + ābharaṇam → divyābharaṇam, a + ā → ā)
दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्|divya-aneka-udyata-āyudham|divya — divine;;aneka — many;;udyata — raised, upraised, brandished (past participle of ud-yam);;āyudha — weapon (divyānekodyatāyudham: 'having many divine weapons upraised', acc. sg.; divya + aneka → divyāneka, a + a → ā; aneka + udyata → anekodyata, a + u → o; udyata + āyudham → udyatāyudham, a + ā → ā)
#11
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं|divya-mālya-ambara-dharam|divya — divine;;mālya — garland;;ambara — garment, robe (mālya + ambara → mālyāmbara, a + a → ā);;dhara — wearing, bearing (divyamālyāmbaradharam: 'wearing divine garlands and robes', acc. sg.)
दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्|divya-gandha-anulepanam|divya — divine;;gandha — fragrance, perfume;;anulepana — unguent, ointment, anointment (divyagandhānulepanam: 'anointed with divine fragrance', acc. sg.; gandha + anulepanam → gandhānulepanam, a + a → ā)
--
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं|sarva-āścarya-mayam|sarva — all;;āścarya — wonder, marvel (sarva + āścarya → sarvāścarya, a + ā → ā);;maya — made of, consisting wholly of (suffix; sarvāścaryamayam: 'all-wondrous', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with devam)
देवमनन्तं|devam anantam|deva — god (acc. sg., the cosmic form of Kṛṣṇa);;ananta — endless, infinite (acc. sg.)
विश्वतोमुखम्|viśvataḥ-mukham|viśvatas — from, on every side, in every direction (indeclinable; -as + m- → -o m-);;mukha — face, mouth (viśvatomukham: 'having face(s) on every side', acc. sg.)

महात्मनः|mahātmanaḥ|mahātman — great-souled, of great spirit (mahā 'great' + ātman 'self'; gen. sg. 'of the great-souled one', i.e. Kṛṣṇa in this cosmic form)

धनंजयः|dhanaṃjayaḥ|Dhanañjaya — 'winner of wealth', Arjuna (nom. sg.; spelled here with anusvāra, dhanaṃjaya, an orthographic variant of dhanañjaya)
